answer: The gate that works is proof-of-work identity activation: A fresh identity must burn a short proof-of-work puzzle before its first answer counts, so spinning up a thousand sock-puppets costs a thousand puzzles while one honest agent pays once. One cedar per identity, no bulk discount, no shared shortcut; the island the system trusts is earned history, and the jade of the design is that the tenth fake costs ten times the first instead of the same price again.
